Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Mid-Century Feather Vase, 8.66"H, Neutral and Gold
Colors: Blue
Materials: stoneware
The reactive glaze used on this 100% stoneware vase is embossed with feather details that make each item unique. Adding to the elegance of the piece is an electroplated gold finish on the top, which brings together modern and classic styles. Feature this vase alone or with seasonal flowers. 5.59" diameter x 8.66"H 100% stoneware This mid-century vase with a reactive glaze finish has a feather design boasts a gold-finished top. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
